rows.en: But we have the bonds we share with friends who fight beside us and hold each other up.
Nobody in this world is perfect. Holding each other up as you go... that's the game called life.
Even if we lose our power again, so long as we keep those bonds, no enemy can stand against us.
That's right! No matter how tough the case, we'll see it through!
True, negative emotions will never disappear from us...
But we are not alone. We can trust our comrades and work together.
And even if we lose the power to fight, we will never lose the heart that wishes for peace.
So even if malice takes shape again, we can overcome it...
Sure, maybe negative emotions really won't ever go away...
But we're not giving up!! Whatever trouble comes, we'll smash it to pieces!
Even if we lose our power to fight again, we won't lose the heart that believes in our friends!
And then we'll join forces and win, no matter what!
It's true negative emotions will never disappear... I've got them inside me, too.
But we can help each other and support each other!
Even powerless, we won't lose the will to help each other! And we'll get past any hardship that comes!
As long as I've got this heart, a little spare change, and tomorrow's underwear!
True, negative emotions will never disappear from us...
But we will not stop advancing toward the eradication of war.
We lost our power, but never that resolve!
We will sever the distortion born of negative power! And we will carve open the future!!!
Regis...!! You're still...!!
...Ugh... Regis is... This body of mine is crumbling...
You too will soon... be drawn back to your original worlds...
But do not think that this is the end...!!
Your worlds are filled with strife... Pain and hatred never cease,
and Minus Energy only grows and grows...
Ugly wars steeped in vanity and greed, wearing the skin of justice and noble causes...
Evil is far purer and more beautiful than that...
So long as the world does not change, such folly will be repeated... and one day...
another being of pure evil like me will be born...
...We know that full well.
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have comrades... comrades who fight beside us, whom we can rely on...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. We truly believe that...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what I believe...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But y'know, we've got pals... Pals who fight with us, who we can trust, see...
However rough it gets, team up with those guys and we'll pull through. I believe that, man...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us and trust one another...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have friends... friends who fight alongside us, whom we can believe in...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But see, we've got friends... Friends we trust enough to have our backs...
Whatever the odds, we can get through it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have comrades... comrades who fought beside us, worthy of trust...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it together with our comrades. That's what I believe...
But we have friends... friends who fought with us, whom we can believe in...
Whatever the adversity, with our friends around, we can overcome it. That's what we believe!
But we have friends... friends joined to us by our bonds...
Whatever the adversity, we can surely overcome it together with our friends. That's what we believe...
But we have comrades... comrades who fought alongside us...
Whatever the adversity, we can overcome it with our comrades. I believe it, and I'll live by it...
We did it...!!
...That you, Seravee!?
I've reinitialized the entire enemy domain!! It's now under my complete control!!

This W leader block: CHARA_NAME 4 = W (Shotaro) plays #359/#361/#363, 198 = W (Philip) plays #360/#362; extracted labels correct and wording agrees (Philip 'boku', Shotaro rough). Continues Shotaro's #359 in story_175.
'Boku-tachi ni teki wa nai' (no enemy for us) rendered 'no enemy can stand against us'.
'Nanjiken' (tough case) kept as detective flavour for Shotaro.

Unlabelled leader block TextIdOffset+316+R3 (4 lines per leader). Chain at pc 3219 (Pt_Chara_Check 11,1,6,12,2,7,13,3,8,14,4,9,15,5,10) sets R3: Ultraman 0, Rider 1 4, Nu 8, Seven 12, RX 16, Zeta 20, Taro 24, (Den-O and W have explicit named lines), God Gundam 34, Mebius 38, Wing Zero 47, Zero 51, OOO 55, 00 59. So #364-367 Wing Zero, #368-371 Zero, #372-375 OOO, #376-379 00. Wording matches (peace = Heero, rough = Zero, 'little spare change and tomorrow's underwear' = Eiji, eradication of war / distortion = Setsuna). Speaker label = leader (CHARA_NAME[R0]). Reply to Regis's dying speech (#306-314, story_175).
Eiji admits the 'negative feelings' (his desire) are inside him too; subject 'I' from 'ore no naka ni mo'.
Tightened to fit two lines: 'power to fight' compressed to 'Even powerless'; 'mata' (and also) kept as 'And'.
Eiji's signature motto from OOO (a little money and tomorrow's underwear), kept recognisable. No subject in source; 'I' because it is Eiji's personal motto.
'Senso konzetsu' = eradication of war (Celestial Being's goal); formal Setsuna voice.
'Yugami' = distortion (00 term); 'mirai wo kirihiraku' = carve open the future.

Unused; silence, speaker unknown (likely leader).

Polite 'imasu' plus 'ze' in #419: mixed register, speaker uncertain (Zero or OOO by position).
